shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && cat AGENTS.md && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -100'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -i \"view transition|viewTransition|transitionTypes|useViewTransition|Suspense|loading\\.tsx\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -200 && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,320p' app/globals.css && sed -n '1,220p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '43,190p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && sed -n '210,310p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md && node -e \"import('react').then(r=>console.log({version:r.version, ViewTransition:typeof r.ViewTransition, addTransitionType:typeof r.addTransitionType}))\" && rg --files app lib"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '260,455p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && cat package-lock.json | head -100 && npm view react@canary version && npm view next@16.4.2 peerDependencies --json"

/bin/bash -lc "npm view react version && npm view react-dom version && npm view @types/react@canary version && npm view @types/react-dom@canary version && node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/next/package.json'); console.log(p.version)\" && cat tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @types/react version && npm view @types/react-dom version && cat tsconfig.json && npm view next@16.4.2 version'
/bin/bash -lc 'rg --files public app lib | head -100 && rg -n "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"import('react').then(r=>console.log({version:r.version, ViewTransition:typeof r.ViewTransition, addTransitionType:typeof r.addTransitionType}))\" && rg -n \"interface ViewTransitionProps|type ViewTransitionProps|ViewTransition\" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -30 && sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | tail -40"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx && sed -n '1,120p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && sed -n '1,120p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,320p' app/globals.css && cat package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- package.json app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx app/globals.css"
